name: IR blaster - NOT WORKING ON CURTANA YET
description: hmos2sweet's IR driver sends through /dev/lirc0 (ir-spi LIRC driver). The curtana kernel has no LIRC/ir-spi driver (CONFIG_RC_CORE is off; the IR LED is on spidev), so this stays off until the driver is ported. The consumer IR HDI service loads a small driver that sends the patterns through the sweet IR LED (ir-spi, /dev/lirc0) instead of Huawei's IR chip.
